country: TBC — DICEUS is founded in Ukraine (associated country, fully eligible for Horizon Europe) and operates offices in Europe, the United States, and the Middle East. description: DICEUS is a European product-led InsurTech company (founded 2011) developing and commercialising configurable, ready-made insurance software products. It has evolved from a custom software engineering provider into a product-focused technology company with 250+ professionals and 150+ delivered projects across insurance, banking, healthcare, logistics, and financial services. Its portfolio is built on a shared cloud-native, API-first, modular technology foundation with embedded, reusable AI services. As an SME it seeks funding for its own product-led R&D, primarily DIRECT single-company instruments, but is open to indirect (consortium / cascade) routes.
